content:
The women's team event in Archery at the 2012 Summer Olympics took place on July 29, 2012. The event involved teams of three archers representing their respective countries competing in the team round.

The gold medal was won by the South Korean team, consisting of Ki Bo-bae, Lee Sung-jin, and Choi Hyeon-ju. They defeated the Chinese team in the final to claim the top spot on the podium.

The silver medal was awarded to the Chinese team, which included Cheng Ming, Fang Yuting, and Xu Jing. They had a strong performance throughout the competition but ultimately fell short in the final against South Korea.

The bronze medal went to the Japanese team, made up of Ren Hayakawa, Yuki Hayashi, and Kaori Kawanaka. They defeated the Russian team in the bronze medal match to secure a spot on the podium.

Overall, the women's team event in Archery at the 2012 Summer Olympics showcased some of the best female archers in the world competing at the highest level for their countries. The competition was intense, with teams displaying skill, precision, and teamwork to earn their places on the medal stand.
